_comment: UltraRT reflection material overrides (docs/reflections.md). Deployed next to UltraRT.dll; a second file with the same
name in BepInEx/config is loaded after this one, so its rules win. Rules apply in order; every matching rule applies.
Match fields (globs, * and ?, case-insensitive, all given ones must match): material, texture (main texture), shader.
Set fields: class (ULTRAKILL SurfaceType name, Other or Mirror: resets to that class's defaults first), roughness,
metalness, f0, specWeight (0-1, relative to -ultrart-spec-weight), reflMode (none, specular, blend, additive),
reflStrength (0-1, blend/additive). Material names are matched without ' (Instance)'.
Run with -ultrart-matdump to get BepInEx/ultrart/material-classes-SCENE.tsv with every material's result.
lit (0-1): lit weight, 0 = fullbright as the game draws unlit materials, 1 = fully relit (docs/materials.md, 'Lit weight').
A rule with only lit leaves the reflection parameters alone; on baked atlas slots it applies through the slot's original material.

rules.note: CRT glass: a clear RT reflection (about 25% head-on, user asked for more; Fresnel towards grazing) replacing the game's additive cubemap; limited to the screen by the game's _ReflectionMask
same layout as the shop terminal
fake mirrors: 1-4's shelf room (3TR - Shelf Room/3TR Nonstuff/Table/Cube) and others; the game blends a generic cubemap at 0.35, ours is a real mirror (docs/reflections.md, 'Fake mirrors')
the credits museum's bathroom mirrors: a painted reflection, now a real one

stained glass: light passes, tinted by the panes; the leading blocks (docs/materials.md, Stained glass; 2026-11-18). Opaque StainedGlassBlue/Red/Big (1-1 to 1-4), transparent StainedGlass1A 10-19, StainedGlassBigTransparent, StainedGlassGabriel1, StainedGlassLit
weapons (first-person viewmodel and V1 third-person; docs/viewmodel.md): painted metal

unlit gore (0-2 has 953, every kill spawns more): fullbright gibs glowed red in dark halls. 0.6 (2026-11-18, bench/suites/unlit-a.json) still glowed for the user (playtest 2026-11-20: not a fan of glowing gibs); 1 since 2026-11-21: lit by the room like GibsLit
1-1 statues, unlit in the game: stone in sunlight. Weight not yet checked in a screenshot (the statue is switched off at the route poses)
6-1 soul tubes, P-2 arches: partial. Not yet checked in a screenshot
NPC and prop portraits (unlit cut-outs): partial so they sit in the room's light. Not yet checked in a screenshot
